zh.title: 被流放的英雄
zh.summary: 雪地开场、基础战斗与雪魈王。
zh.lead: 沿雪地推进到雪魈王，先看关键节点，再按需要查看战斗和拾取提示。逐项收集位置仍待实机核验。

atGlance.label: 推进目标
atGlance.value: 穿过开场雪地，击败雪魈王

atGlance.label: 路线节点

sections.heading: 关键推进节点
items: 雪崩后的开场沿通路前进，找到剑形存档点。取得刀斧后，用前几场战斗熟悉轻重攻击、防御、锁定和精力消耗。
面对普通敌人时保留一部分精力。守住一轮攻击，再用短连击反击；路上留意剧情物品“押送令”。
继续穿过雪地。重新看到此前的存档点时，检查高处的推车机关，开启返回存档点的捷径。
进入雪魈王战前整理装备和恢复道具。击败首领后，剧情将带领卡赞进入下一段任务。

sections.heading: 路上容易忽略的事
items: 开场取得武器后先练习防御与精力管理：挡住攻击也会消耗精力，连续反击前要留出退开的余量。
击败前段敌人后检查剧情物品“押送令”。这是一条已核对的拾取提示，不代表本章收集项目已经列全。
在高处打开推车捷径后，可先返回存档点整理装备，再进入首领战。

sections.heading: 雪魈王战斗要点
items: 与首领保持能看清起手动作的距离。它向前冲锋时侧向闪避，较长的连击结束后再上前反击。
战斗后半段留意落冰和正面冰锥。先躲开攻击，再趁空档输出，并留精力给下一次防御或闪避。

en.title: The Banished Hero
en.summary: The opening snowfield, combat basics and the Snow Yeti King.
en.lead: Follow the snowy opening to the Snow Yeti King. Check the route first, then jump to combat and pickup notes as needed. Collectible locations still need hands-on verification.

atGlance.label: Objective
atGlance.value: Cross the opening snowfield and defeat the Snow Yeti King

atGlance.label: Route
atGlance.value: Sword checkpoint → combat tutorial → cart shortcut → boss

atGlance.label: Story item checked
atGlance.value: Transport order; full collectible list still unverified

atGlance.label: Guide status
atGlance.value: Original route summary, not a complete collectible guide

sections.heading: Key progression points
items: Follow the opening path after the avalanche and activate the sword-shaped checkpoint. Once you receive the paired blades, use the first encounters to learn attacks, guarding, target lock and stamina use.
Keep some stamina in reserve against ordinary enemies. Defend through their attack sequence, answer with a short combo and watch for the transport order story item.
Continue through the snowfield. When the earlier checkpoint comes back into view, examine the cart above it to open a return shortcut.
Check your equipment and recovery items before the Snow Yeti King. The story moves into the next mission after the fight.

sections.heading: Things to watch for
items: Practice guarding and stamina management after getting your first weapon. Blocking also costs stamina, so leave enough to move away after a counterattack.
Check for the transport order story item after the early encounter. This is one checked pickup, not a complete list for the mission.
After opening the cart shortcut, you can return to the checkpoint to review your equipment before the boss.

sections.heading: Snow Yeti King: battle notes
items: Stay far enough away to read the wind-up. Dodge sideways when it charges, and counter after a longer attack string ends.
Later in the fight, watch for falling ice and a frontal ice attack. Evade first, then strike while reserving stamina for another guard or dodge.

sections.heading: Before the next mission
items: Follow the story after Yetuga. Trials of the Frozen Mountain now has route and collectible notes; continue through the mission directory.

zh.lead: 以存档点和收集地标串联雪山路线，完成试炼后挑战刀锋幻影。地名以英文对照辅助查找；本页为文字路线，图片后续补充。

sections.heading: 雪山推进路线
items: 从区域传送入口选择本章，激活试炼雪原（Snowfield of Trials）存档点；先分配获得的技能点。
沿山路完成武器与战斗教学，学会投枪后，用它处理远处目标；经过冻湖（Frozen Lake）时检查洞穴支路。
继续到冰峡谷（Ice Canyon），穿过木桥并攀登塔楼；整理恢复道具后沿剩余山路进入刀锋幻影场地。

第二块：冻湖分岔处，野猪所在路线旁的左侧洞穴深处。

sections.heading: 刀锋幻影战斗要点
items: 先辨认武器：巨剑连击、双持快攻与长枪攻击的节奏不同，不要在第一击结束时就抢攻。
长枪投掷后可能接瞬移砸击，锤击会在前方形成红色尖刺；躲开之后仍要观察后续动作。
第二阶段增加爪击并更频繁瞬移；看到爆发攻击提示时使用教学中的反击操作，以自己的键位设置为准。

en.title: Trials of the Frozen Mountain
en.summary: Snowfield, Frozen Lake and Ice Canyon trials, three Soulstones and Blade Phantom.
en.lead: Follow checkpoint landmarks through Stormpass. This text route covers progression and collectible checks; screenshots will follow.

atGlance.label: Objective
atGlance.value: Complete the trials and defeat Blade Phantom

atGlance.label: Route
atGlance.value: Snowfield of Trials → Frozen Lake → Ice Canyon → boss

atGlance.label: Collectibles

atGlance.label: Next destination
atGlance.value: The Crevice, then Forgotten Temple

sections.heading: Mountain route
items: Select the mission at the region portal, activate Snowfield of Trials and assign the new skill point.
Complete the weapon and combat tutorials. After learning Javelin, use it for distant targets; check the cave branch at Frozen Lake.
Continue through Ice Canyon, cross the wooden bridge and climb the tower. Prepare recovery items before following the final mountain path to Blade Phantom.

Second: inside the left cave near the Frozen Lake fork and boar route.
Third: on the cliff after two ladder climbs in Ice Canyon, above the Nexus branch.
It does not appear on the first visit.

sections.heading: Blade Phantom: battle notes
items: Read the weapon: greatsword strings, rapid dual-wield attacks and spear moves have different rhythms. Avoid punishing the first hit.
A spear throw can lead into a teleporting slam; hammer attacks create red spikes ahead. Watch for follow-ups after evading.
Phase two adds claw attacks and more teleports. Use the taught Counterattack for Burst Attack warnings, following your configured controls.

zh.title: 被遗忘的神庙
zh.summary: 神庙入口、地下旋转机关、三块鬼石与 Viper。
zh.lead: 从遗迹入口深入地下，停止旋转机关并打开首领大门。按地标核对支路，精确房间截图留待补充。

atGlance.label: 推进目标
atGlance.value: 停止三处机关，返回神庙之心挑战 Viper

atGlance.label: 路线节点
atGlance.value: 入口 → 地下 Daphrona → 深处机关 → 电梯 → 首领

atGlance.label: 收集核对

sections.heading: 从遗迹进入神庙
items: 激活入口存档点。初段岔路右侧检查生命典籍，返回后沿左路推进，注意高处弓箭手。
开门进入神庙，楼梯右侧检查支路；入口附近有吟游诗人商人和冥界能量升级。
首领大门暂时关闭，先操作附近拉杆，再沿路线乘电梯进入地下，与 Daphrona 对话。

sections.heading: 停止地下旋转机关
items: 调整石像，使其朝向与同列石像一致；升起平台后通过梯子到达控制装置，停止第一部分。
继续到深处处理敌人，再完成第二组石像机关；检查显露的鬼石并操作第二处装置。
沿下行路线到最后一处装置，停止全部旋转机构；返回电梯，击败沿途强敌，上行拉杆开门并在首领前休整。

鬼石二：神庙入口楼梯前的右侧支路，处理两名敌人后查看角落。
鬼石三：深处第二组石像机关完成后显露，用投枪击碎。
Daphrona 提供鬼石解放服务；本章先完成对话，具体强化选项见菜单。

sections.heading: Viper 战斗要点
items: 第一阶段长枪有延迟起手，等攻击真正到来再防御；投掷武器后仍可能接突进。
枪尖发光并后撤蓄势时留意抓取，拉开距离，不要用普通防御硬接。
第二阶段匕首较快、拳击较慢，分开判断节奏；看到手掌拍地时准备躲开随后投石。
困难时可检查场地前白色召唤点，使用对应的循环 Lacrima 召唤助战灵体。

en.title: Forgotten Temple
en.summary: Temple entrance, rotating underground mechanisms, three Soulstones and Viper.
en.lead: Descend into the temple, stop its mechanisms and open the boss gate. Use landmarks for branch checks; precise room screenshots will follow.

atGlance.label: Objective
atGlance.value: Stop three mechanisms and reach Viper

atGlance.label: Route
atGlance.value: Entrance → Daphrona → depths → elevator → boss

atGlance.label: Collectibles
atGlance.value: Three Soulstones; Vitality Tome and Netherworld Energy upgrade near the entrance

atGlance.label: Characters
atGlance.value: Bard merchant and Daphrona; Jarling requires a later return

sections.heading: Entering the temple
items: Activate the first Nexus. Check the initial right branch for a Vitality Tome, then return left and watch the archer above.
Enter the temple and inspect the branch right of the stairs. The entrance area includes the Bard merchant and a Netherworld Energy upgrade.
The boss gate is locked. Operate the nearby lever, descend by elevator and speak to Daphrona.

sections.heading: Route illustration
sections.alt: Exploration near the temple entrance.
sections.caption: Exploration near the temple entrance.
sections.sourceLabel: 3DM Guide Team · original page 22

sections.heading: Stopping the rotating mechanisms
items: Align statues with others in their row. Use the raised platform and ladder to reach the first control device.
Continue deeper, clear enemies and solve the second statue puzzle. Check the exposed Soulstone and operate the second device.
Descend to the final device, stop the machinery, then return by elevator. Defeat the tough enemy, open the gate with the upper lever and rest before Viper.

sections.heading: Exploration illustration
sections.alt: An interior passage through the temple.
sections.caption: An interior passage through the temple.
sections.sourceLabel: 3DM Guide Team · original page 29

sections.heading: Collectibles and characters
items: Soulstone one: behind breakable wooden barriers left of the pre-temple fork.
Soulstone two: the corner of the right branch before the entrance stairs, past two enemies.
Soulstone three: exposed by the second statue puzzle; break it with Javelin.
Daphrona offers Soulstone unleashing. Finish her dialogue and check the available upgrades.
After Jar Enthusiasts, return from Depths of the Forgotten Temple, pass the second rotating trap and check the small jar left of the descending stairs.

sections.heading: Viper: battle notes
items: Phase-one spear attacks have delayed starts. Guard when the strike arrives; a weapon throw can lead into a rush.
Watch for a glowing spear tip and a drawn-back stance before the grab. Move away rather than relying on normal guarding.
Phase two mixes fast dagger strikes with slower punches. A palm slammed into the ground warns of a following rock throw.
If needed, check the white summon point before the arena and spend the corresponding Circular Lacrima to summon a Spirit of Advocacy.

sections.heading: After the battle
items: Complete the story and hub dialogue after Viper, then continue to First Act of Revenge through the mission navigation. Return for the Jarling after completing its later prerequisite.

items: After the prerequisite, return to the temple depths and check left of the descending stairs beyond the second rotating trap.

zh.summary: 沿村落、码头与中央仓库推进，核对三块鬼石并挑战 Volbaino。

sections.heading: 村落与仓库路线
items: 从山丘小屋（Cabin on the Hill）沿主路下行，抵达洞口前先观察地面的吞噬者，避免被抓后抛下悬崖。
继续到村落码头（Phraugh Village Dock），打开捷径附近大门，再向中央仓库推进。
从中央仓库入口下落进入村庄支路，探索梯子建筑和强敌房间；返回主线，打开首领通路。

鬼石二：码头捷径附近的大门打开后，立即查看左侧。

items: 战前检查封火项链与火焰净化药水；长连击结束后再短打反击，保留精力。
武器插地后会接锤击冲击波，先拉开距离；后半场留意拔出武器后的残留火焰。
看到准备点燃下层场地的动作，利用梯子到上层避火；不要站在投出的尖刺与首领之间。

zh.title: 可疑的恶臭
zh.summary: 穿过坍塌矿山与毒池，核对三块鬼石，准备解毒并挑战 Aratra。

sections.heading: 矿山与毒池路线
items: 先激活坍塌矿山（Collapsed Mine）存档点，推进并打开返回捷径；经过瀑布时停下检查远处鬼石。
继续穿过蜘蛛卵附近的大房间，抵达瘴气深处（Poisoned Depths）；与吟游诗人对话并准备解毒道具。

鬼石二：瘴气深处下坡底部右侧裂缝，通往毒池里的小岩台。

sections.heading: Aratra 战前准备与打法

分别锁定前肢或腹部：破坏前肢减少相关攻击，破坏腹部可暂时压制毒攻击；首领退回洞穴后会恢复。

sections.heading: Mine and poison-pool route
items: Activate Collapsed Mine and open its return shortcut. Check the distant Soulstone at the waterfall.
Continue past the large spider-egg chamber to Poisoned Depths. Speak to the Bard and prepare poison-cleansing items.
Follow rock islands and ramps to Bottom of the Cave, recover on dry ground and approach the boss.

Second: take the right crevice at the bottom of the Poisoned Depths ramp to the small rock island.

sections.heading: Aratra: preparation and battle notes
items: Bring poison-cleansing items and resistant accessories. Explore barrel side paths before the fight to destroy small-spider entrances and reduce reinforcements.
Target forelegs or abdomen: breaking legs limits associated attacks; breaking the abdomen suppresses venom temporarily. Parts regenerate after its cave retreat.
Use Javelin on its back during a wall retreat. Delay counters for Burst strings and watch for grabs after webs.

items: 准备火抗饰品和火焰净化道具；防御仍可能积累元素状态，不能只看生命条。
连击末尾砸击射程很长，后滚未必安全；观察武器发光和延迟，选择侧向避让。
旋转喷火阶段以移动避让为主，并给最后的跳起砸击留出空间；后期砸地还可能接延迟范围爆炸。

items: 从采石营地（Quarry Camp Site）到蜘蛛区域，先处理会召唤爆炸小蜘蛛的大蜘蛛，再探索下方平台。

sections.heading: Maluca 两阶段打法
items: 第一阶段双巨剑动作较慢，注意延迟；后撤转身会接飞射攻击，背身挑衅时直接上前攻击可能吃反击。
变形后开场插剑接大范围冲击，先拉开距离；之后刀剑连击明显加快，重新观察节奏。
刀发光后回拉并跳起可能是抓取，不要普通防御硬接；瞬移斩的发光提示早于实际出手。

sections.heading: Maluca: two-phase battle notes
items: Phase-one greatswords are slow and delayed. A turning backstep precedes projectiles; attacking a back-turned taunt can trigger a counter.
After transformation, the opening sword plunge leads to a large shockwave. Move away, then relearn the faster sword rhythm.
A glowing drawn-back blade and jump can signal a grab. Do not rely on normal guarding; teleport-slash glow precedes the actual strike.
Cleanse Chaos before resource limits shrink. When he screams with a visible ripple, seek a safe opportunity to interrupt healing.

sections.heading: 矿山推进路线

经过劳役营与电梯，在下降后的牢房支路查找档案和项链。
沿地下竖井木桥推进，再到幽暗洞穴（Cave of Gloom）；整理瘟疫净化补给后进入首领场地。

sections.heading: 三块鬼石与人物物品

鬼石二：木桥前看右侧横梁，用投枪击碎。

sections.heading: 罐子精灵

sections.heading: Shactuka 战斗要点
items: 准备瘟疫净化，优先瞄准头部弱点。
高跳落地后仍要判断续招，在防御与闪避之间切换，避免抢攻。
带瘟疫的攻击尽量闪避，普通防御或精准防御仍可能积累状态。

sections.heading: 矿山后的任务入口

sections.heading: Mine progression

Continue through the labor camp and elevator; inspect the cell branches below for records and the necklace.

sections.heading: Jarling location

sections.heading: Shactuka: battle notes
items: Prepare Plague cleansing and target the head weak point.
Read follow-ups after the high leap; alternate guarding and dodging rather than attacking early.
Evade Plague attacks where possible; guards can still accumulate the status.

sections.heading: Follow-up missions

sections.heading: 水城与城堡推进
items: 从商业区（Commercial District）沿平台下降，第一处落脚阳台先检查后再下行。
经过水闸（Floodgate）与混沌区域，到 Aldevir 城塞；城堡左右楼梯分别连到高处支路和图书馆。
整理水属性净化补给，沿主路进入王座房挑战 Trokka。

sections.heading: 五块鬼石与书架暗室
items: 鬼石一：商业区首个下落阳台前端。
鬼石二：水闸两段长梯后的树木庭院，打破巷内房门木障。
鬼石三：混沌区域存档点前的右路尽头门后。
鬼石四：城堡右楼梯高处路线的梯子左侧。

圆盘碎片：Aldevir 城塞大门右侧窄巷地面，保留作后续支线条件。

sections.heading: 罐子精灵
items: 图书馆二层桥左侧书架间的角落小罐；旁边发光书另通鬼石暗室。

sections.heading: Trokka 战斗要点
items: 尽量缩短距离，在安全空档打断施法，伞形武器的爆发攻击按提示反击。
场内红色水母会造成毒状态，蓝色水母可恢复精力，移动时分清颜色。

sections.heading: 战后任务入口
items: 战后查看新增 Lacrima、Valus 的斧头任务；找 Tristan 查看“单相思”，目的地 Ivy Annex，完成后再继续山脉主线或回访收集。

sections.heading: City and castle route

sections.heading: Five Soulstones and bookcase secret
items: First: the initial drop’s balcony.
Second: the barricaded house near the tree courtyard above Floodgate.
Third: behind the door at the pre-Chaos right branch’s end.

Fifth: interact with the glowing book between bookshelves left of the upper library bridge.
Disk fragment: on the ground in the alley right of Aldevir Citadel’s large door; keep it for later missions.

items: The corner jar between bookshelves left of the upper library bridge; the glowing book separately opens a Soulstone room.

sections.heading: Trokka: battle notes

Red jellyfish inflict poison; blue ones restore stamina. Identify them before moving through the arena.

sections.heading: Follow-up missions

sections.heading: 山谷与传送路线

经过深渊桥（Abyssal Bridge）和传送段落，每次回到洞穴重新核对支路，再沿最终路线进入 Bellerian 场地。

sections.heading: 鬼石与吟游诗人房间

鬼石二：吟游诗人路线附近第一段楼梯上方，右侧高台用投枪击碎。

sections.heading: 罐子精灵

sections.heading: Bellerian 战斗要点
items: 准备火、土、雷属性净化道具，观察实际招式再选择补给。
寻找施法空档打断；召唤骷髅时优先处理蓄能目标，减少不死增援。

sections.heading: 战后关联任务

sections.heading: 要塞与桥段推进

sections.heading: 五块鬼石与圆盘碎片

sections.heading: 战后任务条件

声波攻击先识别合唱队位置，再选移动方向；不要只盯着首领本人。

sections.heading: 碎片核对与后续

sections.heading: 皇宫推进与旋转机关
items: 从大教堂入口（Cathedral Entrance）打开隐藏阶梯，下行检查左路，再沿路线到压力板房间。
踩板旋转房间后，从原来进入的门出去核对新通道；到 Corrupted Lounge 先查看结局条件，再与 Daphrona 对话。
继续经弯曲阳台、皇宫花园和地下室到最后场地，进入前补充恢复道具。

sections.heading: 最后四块鬼石
items: 鬼石一：隐藏階梯下左路尽头。
鬼石二：旋转房间后从入口门返回的新通道。
鬼石三：Corrupted Lounge 后弯曲阳台柱顶，用投枪。
鬼石四：地下室返回皇宫后的正前房间，下一门前左侧假墙。

sections.heading: 罐子精灵
items: 皇宫花园上阶后右侧阳台尽头的小罐。

sections.heading: Ozma 战斗与后续阶段
items: 第一阶段优先处理地面混沌长枪，避免堆积；准备火、水与混沌净化，近距离观察连击。
第二阶段实体攻击与混沌招式分开应对，混沌攻击优先闪避；不要因第一条血量耗尽而停止观察。
部分结局路线还有第三阶段，保留恢复、反击爆发攻击并在疲竭窗口处决。三阶段本身不能单独确认真结局。

sections.heading: 结局选择与收尾
items: 真结局准备：十五份金色档案与关键支线完成后，在 Daphrona 对话中确认选择“I must know the truth”。选项未出现时先回查收集和支线，不要把任意选项当作同一路线。
战胜最终首领后完成记忆房间的互动与剧情。普通、锁链及真结局由分支选择和前置决定，不能只用首领阶段数判断。

sections.heading: 通关后回访与新周目
items: 通关后先在当前周目回访遗漏收集；开始新周目前核对任务菜单，确认确实要进入第二旅程。本站十六章文字路线已齐，截图与完整支线仍继续补充。

sections.heading: Palace and rotation mechanism
items: Open the hidden stairs from Cathedral Entrance, inspect the lower-left branch and reach the pressure-plate room.
Rotate the room, exit through the entrance door and check the revealed path. At Corrupted Lounge, review ending requirements before Daphrona’s dialogue.
Continue through the curved balcony, palace garden and basement; replenish recovery before the final arena.

sections.heading: Final four Soulstones
items: First: the lower-left hidden-stair path.
Second: the path exposed behind the rotated room’s entrance.
Third: pillar above the curved balcony.
Fourth: the left false wall before the next door in the forward room after the basement.

sections.heading: Jarling location
items: The jar at the end of Imperial Palace Garden’s upper-right balcony.

sections.heading: Ozma and later phases
items: Clear embedded Chaos spears in phase one; prepare Fire, Water and Chaos cleansing and read strings at close range.
Distinguish physical and Chaos attacks in phase two, favouring evasion for Chaos; remain alert after a health bar empties.
Some ending routes add phase three. Reserve healing, counter Burst Attacks and use exhaustion openings for Brutal Attacks; three phases alone do not prove the true ending.

sections.heading: Ending choice and conclusion
items: With fifteen gold records and key bonus missions complete, confirm “I must know the truth” with Daphrona. If absent, recheck collection and missions before proceeding.
After victory, complete the memory-room interactions and scene. Ending prerequisites and dialogue choices distinguish the branches, not boss phase count alone.

sections.heading: Postgame cleanup and New Game+
items: Replay missions for missed collectibles before starting New Game+. Check the mission menus before committing to the second journey. All sixteen text routes are available; screenshots and full side-mission guides remain in progress.
